checks.finding: Primary labeled the graph universal while ordinary non-RUN allocation was collapsed to a success-only edge.
checks.repair: Scope corrected to bounded RUN slice; normal allocator is an explicit referenced-but-not-modeled terminal.

checks.finding: CURRENT_TRANSITION_GATE had no modeled TRUE destination; CANDIDATE_OUTPUT was marked terminal while having outgoing edges.
checks.repair: Promotion/integration removed from RUN path and represented as external authority cuts.

checks.finding: CANDIDATE_OUTPUT ↔ HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_GATE could repeat without a retry budget, contradicting bounded-loop coverage.
checks.repair: Post-RUN promotion cycle removed from executable RUN projection.

checks.finding: monotonic_ms held elapsed values derived from wall-clock timestamps rather than a monotonic clock.
checks.repair: monotonic_ms set null; elapsed_from_first_durable_ms records derived elapsed time explicitly.

checks.finding: Human acceptance is legitimate product authority but was represented inside the RUN path.
checks.repair: Moved to external authority-cut annotation; worker RUN requires no human routing.

checks.finding: Primary declared projection-only, but a hand-authored graph can still drift before parity automation exists.
checks.repair: Corrected graph marks parity PROPOSED_NOT_EXECUTED and generated_from_sources=false; executable contracts remain truth.

strongest_likely_mistake.statement: Primary structural coverage PASS implied the represented graph had only bounded loops.
strongest_likely_mistake.critique: Structural TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN/ERROR coverage missed a semantic unbounded promotion cycle because authority-cut nodes were not classified as decision nodes and one terminal node had outgoing edges.
strongest_likely_mistake.correction: Coverage must include terminal-outdegree=0 plus cycle/SCC checks, not only decision-label coverage.
